title: On the hedging problem in general 1D diffusion markets
summary: We develop a PDE-based methodology for pricing and hedging European contingent claims in general one-dimensional diffusion markets characterized solely by their scale function and speed measure, possibly without a classical SDE representation, and with constant interest rate. We derive a hedging equation whose solution generates a self-financing hedging strategy and provide sufficient conditions on scale, speed, and interest rate, under which this strategy achieves the minimal hedging capital, expressed through the no free lunch with vanishing risk (NFLVR) condition.
